description: Prices car insurance for every featured insurer. Insurers that do not take the car or the driver are listed under declined. Each plan has its insurer, price in S$ with GST, the date the price was checked, excess, key cover limits and a buy link. Prices come from the broker's stored price tables for Singapore. No answer is required: one not given uses the quote form's default, and the reply says so. This is information, not advice to buy any plan.

age.description: The main driver's age in years.

car.description: The make and model in words, such as "Honda Vezel" or "Toyota Corolla Altis 1.6".

carAge.description: The car's age in years. Or give regDate (the registration date).

claims.description: Number of at-fault claims in the last 3 years.

dob.description: Main driver's date of birth. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

experience.description: Years the driver has held a licence.

job.description: Whether the driver works indoors or outdoors.

licenceYears.description: How many years of driving experience do you have?.

limit.description: The most plans to return, counted from the top of the order. 10 when not given. The reply says how many plans were found in all.

married.description: Whether the main driver is married.

meritCertificate.description: Certificate of Merit. "no" when not given.

model.description: What is your car model?. The list depends on brand.

offPeak.description: Off-peak car (red plate). "no" when not given.

rankBy.description: The order of the plans. "price": lowest price first (the default). "value": highest published value score first. Neither is advice.

regDate.description: When was the car registered?. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.
